curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what a Class D license covers, then the in-person application and each document: name and birth date, citizenship or status, identity, two residence proofs and a Social Security number, all valid originals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per document rule; a contrast card for one document doing double duty versus two residence proofs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a document and asking what it proves or whether it is accepted.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover why a teen needs a sponsor, what the sponsor accepts and confirms, how long sponsorship lasts, who may sponsor, and when proof of insurance replaces a sponsor.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for sponsor duties and eligible sponsors; contrast cards for relative sponsors versus insurance and the sibling or spouse age condition.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a teen's family situation and asking who may sponsor.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show why a permit is needed, the tests an adult passes, the extra age and driver education rules for teens, and the signed application from the driving school.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for adult and teen permit requirements; contrast cards for the two paths and the form that appears twice.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking what a given applicant needs before a permit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the companion rules: never alone, two years on a regular license, the age rules by relationship, family in back, written permission, the extra back-seat rider and darkness driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each companion rule; contrast cards for nineteen versus twenty-one and the twenty-five year old rider.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a would-be companion and asking whether they qualify.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the probationary license and its phone rule, the six-month permit hold, the supervised practice total with its darkness hours, and how sponsors track and verify hours.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the probationary requirements and practice hours; contrast cards for age alone versus all requirements and daytime versus darkness hours.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a teen's progress and asking whether they can move to a probationary license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the GDL name and purpose, the nine-month span, the daytime and midnight windows, passenger limits, the six-month extension, doubled points and the age at which limits end.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each window and limit; contrast cards for the day versus night window, family versus other riders and nine months versus the extension.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a trip by time and passengers and asking whether it is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish with the regular license and renewal, transfers from other states, and what REAL ID is and when it is needed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for renewal, transfers and REAL ID; contrast cards for the renewal windows and the sixty versus thirty day transfer deadlines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on renewal timing, transfer deadlines and REAL ID needs.
